notes:
- The new look uses the classic bottom bar again: same tabs, same hold-and-swipe gesture, same targets. The duplicate bar was removed rather than changed.
- Other Features now has Schedule instead of Activity and Recommendations: airing and announced titles from your own list, with next episode or start date, progress and cover, opening the usual detail sheet.
- Library search reads romaji, English, native and synonym spellings and matches word by word, so "super" finds Dragon Ball Super. Anime and Manga stay separate, and switching type clears the other list's search and filters.
- The new Library has an advanced filter sheet: sort and direction, format, release year, minimum score, genres and Favourites only, with Reset and Apply.
- Home shortcuts show one cover each; the Manga tile fetches the last-read manga cover with a small request only while the new look is open. Cover titles are bolder and can use two lines.
- Interface settings previews both layouts and the selected Library density with your own covers before you choose.
